functional_queries.description: Appuntamenti ricostruiti senza dipendere dagli ID di medico e reparto
functional_queries.sql: SELECT p.fiscal_code, d.full_name AS doctor_name, d.specialty, w.name AS ward_name, a.scheduled_on FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id JOIN doctors d ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id JOIN wards w ON w.ward_id = d.ward_id
SELECT DISTINCT d.full_name AS doctor_name, d.specialty FROM doctors d JOIN appointments a ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id
SELECT DISTINCT w.name AS ward_name FROM wards w JOIN doctors d ON d.ward_id = w.ward_id JOIN appointments a ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id
SELECT d.full_name AS doctor_name, d.specialty, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count FROM appointments a JOIN doctors d ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id GROUP BY d.full_name, d.specialty
SELECT w.name AS ward_name, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count FROM appointments a JOIN doctors d ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id JOIN wards w ON w.ward_id = d.ward_id GROUP BY w.name

functional_queries.description: Numero di appuntamenti per paziente con attività
functional_queries.sql: SELECT p.fiscal_code, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id GROUP BY p.fiscal_code
SELECT substr(scheduled_on, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS appointment_count FROM appointments GROUP BY substr(scheduled_on, 1, 7)
